badge.description: Compact label for category, metadata, or semantic status. Categorical colors and semantic statuses are distinct.
badge.variant: Visual style. Solid uses a restrained tinted background; strong uses a 600-step fill with its matching 50-step foreground in the light theme and a bright fill with dark text in the dark theme; dot shows a colored indicator.
badge.color: Named categorical color or a custom color recipe with base and onStrong values.
badge.statusDescription: Visual product status. Unlike `color`, it uses the danger, warning, success, info, or neutral status tokens. It does not create a live region, and strong status badges are not supported.
badge.roleDescription: Optional native ARIA role. Add status only when a dynamically inserted or updated badge should be announced.
badge.accessibilityDescription: The status prop controls appearance only. Badge does not create a live region by default. Add role="status" for a polite dynamic update; static status badges should remain unannounced.
